description: Antennes Réseau LoRaWAN de la Communauté de Communes Vallée des Baux-Alpilles (CCVBA) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté de Communes Vallée des Baux-Alpilles (CCVBA). Geographical coordinates of LoRaWAN network antennas installed on the Community of Communes Vallée des Baux-Alpilles. Municipalities concerned: Aureille Mouries Maussane the Alpilles The Paradou Saint Remy of Provence Mas Blanc des Alpilles Information: These antennas have been deployed as part of the Parcours Sud Smart Territoires 2022 The creation of a private, ‘deep indoor’ LoRaWAN ... Coverage: Communauté de Communes Vallée des Baux-Alpilles (CCVBA). The portal shows the English title as "LoRaWAN Network antennas of the Community of Communes Vallée des Baux-Alpilles (CCVBA)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Communauté de Communes Vallée des Baux-Alpilles (CCVBA). Its keywords include objets-connectes, iot, antenne, lorawan, parcours-sud-smart-territoires, internet-des-objets. The listing shows 2 download or service links in OGC:WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
